label: context.reference
text:
Use the Gmail Application through world_mcp_gmail. Project EE policy must admit it, and the task needs its exact interface binding and this artifact binding. Installation and connection do not establish server liveness.

Use the server's catalogs for Gmail messages, threads, drafts, labels, attachments, and mailbox capabilities that the connected server actually declares. Current capabilities are declared in mcp.operation_catalog, mcp.tool_catalog, mcp.resource_catalog, mcp.resource_templates and mcp.prompt_catalog from world_mcp_gmail.

Invoke a tool with artifact.send to world_mcp_gmail, label mcp.operation.request, operation gmail.call_tool, and arguments containing the exact catalog tool name and argument object. Use gmail.read_resource, gmail.get_prompt and gmail.complete with catalog identifiers; use gmail.status or gmail.ping to check liveness or negotiated capabilities.

Wait for the returned MCP result, resource, OAuth, event or refusal artifact before reporting an effect. Credentials, OAuth verifiers, tokens and refresh state stay private to the interface; transfer only non-secret handles and status artifacts.
